Wang Maohong (Wang Dao) had a prior longstanding relationship with the emperor, background to the scene.
Wang Dao repeatedly (常) remonstrated with tears, an ongoing action during this period.
Annotation notes that previously (先時) he had by nature always loved wine, providing background before the crossing.
Reference to the time just before crossing the river, relative to the main scene.
Deng Can's Jin Ji records that the emperor personally practiced frugality, contextual background.
Annotation confirms he subsequently never drank again, echoing the later outcome.
